issue.body:
Issue: #5421 

## What I did
- Styled scrollbars using [SimpleBar](https://github.com/Grsmto/simplebar) for nicer scrollbar UX, hoverable, customizable, cross-browser, etc. This is the same lib that codepen.io uses.

Note: I initially tried implementing this with CSS-only but was unable to achieve the desired styling and interaction.

## How to test
Custom scrollbars are present in 4 places.  Resize your window or drag to expand the Sidebar to see the overflow behavior. Omission from the preview iframe is intentional.

**Sidebar** 
![image](https://d1sz9tkli0lfjq.cloudfront.net/items/3W2v450m2b1E23430N1X/Screen%20Recording%202019-02-25%20at%2004.36%20PM.gif?v=14fdca3e)

issue.body:
Issue:#5421 Notifications are obfuscated when the sidebar is narrow.


## What I did
- Made a new directory for notifications components
- Shortened update notification phrasing to "Storybook X.X.X is available"

**Todo**
My goal is to style the notifications like "flash" notifications, which appear above all other content. 
- Extract Notifications from `Sidebar` and put them at the top level of the layout. Currently app notifications live in the sidebar. 


## How to test
- Drag the sidebar to be narrow. If you don't see the update notification, ensure you're cache is cleared and that you're on an older version of SB.
